summary:
The page renders correctly with the new components. The 步骤截图 section now uses `FigureStrip`/`Figure`/`FigureImage`/`FigureLabel`/`FigureText`: each product is a `Group`, and its steps form one horizontally-scrollable strip with the step label and content/action/inputs caption below each screenshot — replacing the previous `createElement("img", …)` workaround. Program checks all pass.

Page structure (unchanged except the screenshot section): 结论 → 核心指标 → 产品对比 → 环节差异 → 典型模式 → 流程明细 → 步骤截图（现用 FigureStrip）→ 问题明细 → 下一步 → 背景信息。
